positionDefinition: 官方資料 numbers 陣列為升冪排序；position 1-5 指排序位置，不代表實際搖出先後順序。
lagDefinition: lag 1 指下一個開獎期，不保證是下一個日曆日；lag 2-5 依序為後續第 2-5 個開獎期。

validation.method: Expanding walk-forward. For each test draw, rank candidates from position-specific trigger-number to next-draw co-occurrence counts using only pairs available before the prediction. Top 5; repeated numbers are allowed among all 39 candidates.

nextDayValidation.method: Expanding walk-forward on exact calendar-day pairs only. A pair is included only when a draw exists on D+1; all training pairs precede each prediction date.

position3TriggerValidation.method: Exact D -> D+1 calendar-day pairs; expanding walk-forward; each trigger-number ranking is based only on earlier pairs. TOP3/TOP5/TOP10 are evaluated separately. Trigger means the number in official ascending-sorted position 3, not physical draw order.
